description: Split-conformal 90% interval for the 50/50 XGBoost+GNN ensemble, from out-of-sample residuals only (results/ensemble_predictions.csv).
quantile_rule: ceil((n_cal + 1) * 0.9)-th smallest |residual| on the calibration half

similarity_warning.definition: max Tanimoto similarity (Morgan r=2, 256 bits) to the training polymers
similarity_warning.reference_set: GNN training split (5,890 polymers) for the held-out analysis; the app compares against all 7,363 polymers, which the deployed XGBoost trained on

scaffold_context.note: Scaffold-split out-of-sample predictions exist for XGBoost only (no GNN), so no scaffold-calibrated ensemble interval is built. These numbers show how much wider errors are on structurally novel polymers.
